rationale.hitl-workflow: HIC gives humans enforceable authority through envelopes, previews, and checkpoints.
rationale.oversight-theater: Argues high-volume HITL becomes powerless liability-transferring rubber-stamping.
rationale.risk-routing: Deterministic risk tiers route actions to execution, advisory state, or escalation.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Intent, provenance, constraints, and previews support informed human judgment.
rationale.rules-based-checks: External policy engines deterministically validate constraints before execution.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Operating envelopes and circuit breakers bound unauthorized agent actions.
rationale.org-governance: Defines policy ownership, accountability, procurement guardrails, and governance cycles.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Translates EU AI Act and NIST oversight requirements into evidence controls.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent evidence receipts and immutable logs preserve inputs and authorized actions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes per-item HITL as meaningful safety and accountability control.
rationale.framework: MV-HIC is a reusable control-plane governance architecture.
rationale.design-only: Architecture is specified operationally, but implementation and evaluation remain future work.
rationale.general-ai: Framework governs consequential AI actions across regulated sectors, not coding specifically.
rationale.agentic: Targets autonomous systems planning and executing consequential multi-step actions.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally analyzes pressured reviewers relying on summaries and confidence badges.
